set: Lanebound arena cards v2 · batches 1–4 · 28 cards

font.name: Barlow Condensed 700 24px caps
font.rules: Barlow Medium 14px/1.34 (12px/1.16 on Crown of the Split)
font.label: Barlow Condensed 600/700 12px

toast720.note: Anh approved 260x60. See brief-v2.md §0 HUD spec delta.

tokens: tokens-cards-arena.css — --k-sig is champagne metallic #9C864C (highlight #B09C68, shade #6A5A34, panel #1C1812). Never objective gold #F2C14E (ΔE ≥ 20). Retired bone #B0A482 is in options/signature-bone/.

cards.name: Clear Speed
cards.when: Holder collects 3 orbs before 1:30
cards.then: Holder +80 XP and +5% move speed for 45 s
cards.toast: Holder +80 XP and +5% move speed for 45 s.
cards.toast720: Holder +80 XP, +5% move speed for 45 s.

cards.name: Spoils of War
cards.when: We win our first teamfight (3+ per side)
cards.then: Team +8% damage for 45 s
cards.toast: Team +8% damage for 45 s.
cards.toast720: Team +8% damage for 45 s.

cards.name: First Claim
cards.when: We take the first zone capture or first claim tick
cards.then: Team +10% damage for 45 s
cards.toast: Team +10% damage for 45 s.
cards.toast720: Team +10% damage for 45 s.

cards.name: Triple Threat
cards.when: Holder reaches 3 kills before 3:00
cards.then: Holder +12% damage for 45 s
cards.toast: Holder +12% damage for 45 s.
cards.toast720: Holder +12% damage for 45 s.

cards.name: Unclaimed Ground
cards.when: No zone capture by either team by 1:30
cards.then: Team +8% move speed for 45 s and +40 XP each
cards.toast: Team +8% move speed for 45 s and +40 XP each.
cards.toast720: Team +8% move speed, +40 XP each, for 45 s.

cards.name: Blood in the Water
cards.when: 8+ total takedowns by 2:00, either side
cards.then: Team takes 9% less damage for 45 s
cards.toast: Team takes 9% less damage for 45 s.
cards.toast720: Team takes 9% less damage for 45 s.

cards.name: Press the Claim
cards.when: A fight ends with 4+ deaths
cards.then: Team +15% damage and +30% claim-window success for 45 s
cards.toast: Team +15% damage and +30% claim-window success for 45 s.
cards.toast720: Team +15% damage, +30% claim success, for 45 s.

cards.name: Shake It Off
cards.when: The enemy draws First Blood
cards.then: Team +8% damage for 45 s
cards.toast: Team +8% damage for 45 s.
cards.toast720: Team +8% damage for 45 s.

cards.name: Hold the Line
cards.when: We lose the first zone capture
cards.then: Team takes 8% less damage for 45 s
cards.toast: Team takes 8% less damage for 45 s.
cards.toast720: Team takes 8% less damage for 45 s.

cards.name: Stubborn
cards.when: Holder has died 3 times before 3:00
cards.then: Holder takes 35% less damage for 60 s
cards.toast: Holder takes 35% less damage for 60 s.
cards.toast720: Holder takes 35% less damage for 60 s.

cards.name: Called Shot
cards.when: We take the first zone capture
cards.then: Mark the enemy with the most champion damage for 60 s (whole team deals +40% to them)
cards.toast: Mark the enemy with the most champion damage for 60 s (whole team deals +40% to them).
cards.toast720: Marks top champion-damage enemy: +40% from the team, 60 s.

cards.name: First Flank
cards.when: We take the first Arena buff
cards.then: That buff lasts +15 s. Team +10% damage for 45 s
cards.toast: That buff lasts +15 s. Team +10% damage for 45 s.
cards.toast720: Buff lasts +15 s. Team +10% damage for 45 s.

cards.name: Long Night
cards.when: A fight within 6 tiles of a buff spot ends with 4+ deaths
cards.then: Team +12% damage for 45 s
cards.toast: Team +12% damage for 45 s.
cards.toast720: Team +12% damage for 45 s.

cards.name: Dead Heat
cards.when: Even at 2:00 (within 1 takedown and 1 zone tick)
cards.then: Team +20% damage for 60 s
cards.toast: Team +20% damage for 60 s.
cards.toast720: Team +20% damage for 60 s.

cards.name: War of Attrition
cards.when: The 4th teamfight begins before 2:00
cards.then: Enemy respawn +4 s for 45 s
cards.toast: Enemy respawn +4 s for 45 s.
cards.toast720: Enemy respawn +4 s for 45 s.

cards.name: Last Orders
cards.when: We trail by 2+ score at 2:00
cards.then: Team takes 8% less damage and deals 10% more for 60 s
cards.toast: Team takes 8% less damage and deals 10% more for 60 s.
cards.toast720: Team takes 8% less, deals 10% more for 60 s.

cards.name: Not Today
cards.when: Enemy takes the first Arena buff (or first capture, if none)
cards.then: Team +16% damage for 45 s
cards.toast: Team +16% damage for 45 s.
cards.toast720: Team +16% damage for 45 s.

cards.name: Regroup
cards.when: We lose a fight with 4+ of ours dead
cards.then: Enemy deals 20% less. Team takes 8% less. Both 45 s
cards.toast: Enemy deals 20% less. Team takes 8% less. Both 45 s.
cards.toast720: Enemy deals 20% less, team takes 8% less, both 45 s.

cards.name: Bounty Hunter
cards.when: Enemy primary carry has died twice by 2:30
cards.then: Team +8% damage and enemy respawn +4 s, both 45 s
cards.toast: Team +8% damage and enemy respawn +4 s, both 45 s.
cards.toast720: Team +8% damage, enemy respawn +4 s, both 45 s.

cards.name: Closing Argument
cards.when: We score 4 takedowns in a row (no deaths between)
cards.then: Team +8% damage for 45 s
cards.toast: Team +8% damage for 45 s.
cards.toast720: Team +8% damage for 45 s.

cards.name: Huntress Specialist
cards.when: Holder plays Huntress and joins a teamfight after 1:30
cards.then: Holder +40% damage for 60 s, team +5% damage for 45 s
cards.toast: Holder +40% damage for 60 s, team +5% damage for 45 s.
cards.toast720: Holder +40% damage 60 s; team +5% damage 45 s.

cards.name: Contest Fury
cards.when: A contested-zone fight ends with 4+ deaths
cards.then: Team +12% damage and +25% tick rate for 45 s
cards.toast: Team +12% damage and +25% tick rate for 45 s.
cards.toast720: Team +12% damage and +25% tick rate for 45 s.

cards.name: Never Say Die
cards.when: We trail by 3+ score before 2:30
cards.then: Team takes 12% less damage and deals 8% more for 60 s
cards.toast: Team takes 12% less damage and deals 8% more for 60 s.
cards.toast720: Team takes 12% less, deals 8% more for 60 s.

cards.name: Last Stand
cards.when: We have lost zone ownership twice, or we trail by 4+ score, by 3:00
cards.then: Team takes 20% less and deals 12% more for 60 s
cards.toast: Team takes 20% less and deals 12% more for 60 s.
cards.toast720: Team takes 20% less, deals 12% more for 60 s.

cards.name: Pillar of the Split
cards.when: Holder joins the first teamfight that starts after 1:30
cards.then: Holder +40% damage and takes 15% less damage, team +5% damage, all for 45 s
cards.toast: Holder +40% damage and takes 15% less damage, team +5% damage, all for 45 s.
cards.toast720: Holder +40% damage, takes 15% less; team +5% damage; all 45 s.

cards.name: Finals Poise
cards.when: We lose the first zone capture
cards.then: Team +16% damage for 45 s
cards.toast: Team +16% damage for 45 s.
cards.toast720: Team +16% damage for 45 s.

cards.name: Crown of the Split
cards.when: We take the first zone capture
cards.then: Team +12% damage for 45 s, and our next claim window that starts within those 45 s cannot be denied: at the 8 s resolve, the zone flips to us and the claim tick scores even if enemies stand in the zone. Lapses if no claim window starts in 45 s
cards.toast: Team +12% damage for 45 s. Next claim window in that time cannot be denied.
cards.toast720: Team +12% damage 45 s; next claim in 45 s cannot be denied.
cards.award: Awarded for a Split or Vernal Invitational win.

cards.name: Convergence Crown
cards.when: Even at 2:00 (within 1 takedown and 1 tick)
cards.then: Team +10% damage and enemy respawn +4 s for 45 s
cards.toast: Team +10% damage and enemy respawn +4 s for 45 s.
cards.toast720: Team +10% damage and enemy respawn +4 s for 45 s.
cards.award: Awarded to starters who win the Grand Convergence.
